pages.scan: I read works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/storyboards-unnumbered/page-05.png with the Read tool and looked at it. Panel 1 (full-width top): the balloon at upper centre reads 'Hello, Ravi. Tell me what brings you in.' Its tail goes to 'ananya'. 'ravi' is at right and silent. The teal label at middle left reads 'PATIENT DETAILS: current vitals · prior health info · allergy panel · AI mic option · patient docs · lab reports'. Panel 2 (full-width middle): the left balloon reads 'May the AI listen and save notes of our talk?' Its tail goes to 'ananya'. The middle balloon reads 'Yes, I agree.' Its long diagonal tail goes to 'ravi' at right. The teal label at right reads 'AI VOICE CONSENT: asked at the first visit, before any voice is saved'. Panel 3 (lower left): the balloon reads 'I've been feeling tired lately.' Its tail goes to 'ravi'. The teal label at bottom left reads 'SOAP NOTES: fill in manually and choose ICD or SNOMED codes, or let AI listen and summarise the conversation'. Panel 4 (lower right): the caption reads 'Technology supports the workflow. The conversation stays human.' 'ananya' is present. 'ravi' is only a dot at the far right edge. Both are silent.
pages.observation: The order mostly works, but there are problems. (1) In panel 1 the PATIENT DETAILS label sits left of and below the opening balloon. A reader may read the long label first, or be unsure whether to read the label or the greeting first. (2) Ravi's 'I've been feeling tired lately.' answers 'Tell me what brings you in' from panel 1. The consent exchange in panel 2 delays that answer. It still reads, but the question-and-answer link is stretched across panels. (3) In panel 2 'Yes, I agree.' sits right next to Ananya's balloon, nearly touching it. Its tail is long and runs diagonally under the consent label to Ravi. Ravi is close to the consent label, so the reader's eye passes the label before landing on Ravi. (4) The AI VOICE CONSENT label touches the right panel frame. The line 'before any voice is saved' has no closing punctuation and nearly touches the box edge. (5) The SOAP NOTES label touches the left panel frame. It is long and narrow (8 lines) and dominates the panel. (6) In panel 4 Ravi is only a dot with his label at the panel edge, which may mean he is mostly out of frame; the intent is unclear. The page is text-heavy with three long UI labels.
